Data format

Source: vignettes/data-format.Rmd
data-format.Rmd

Overview

The data are compiled as one dataset per kind of measurement. Column names are fixed and carry their units (for example diameter_mm); any additional columns are ignored. Some tables have columns that differ by species, such as weight (e.g., diameter_mm vs fronds).

Not every dataset is required: a model without data can use a model pre-fit to a public dataset in kelpbiodata (see Pre-fit models). How the datasets combine into biomass is explained in the Methods overview, and how the data are expected to be collected in Survey design.

Two data format choices to highlight:

  1. Size sample or census. A Nereocystis survey either measures a sample of the counted plants or all of them. With a sample, size data are provided in size_sample, each survey’s total plant count is recorded in the plants column of survey_in_situ, and a size model is used to estimate size of unmeasured plants. If every plant is measured, sizes are recorded in the size_census table and each survey’s total plant count is calculated automatically. For Macrocystis, it is assumed that all plants are measured and sizes are recorded in the size_census table.
  2. Site and year, or survey. These methods are designed to estimate annual biomass at each site: the weight, size, and cover calibration models have site and year effects, and the tissue models estimate one ratio or fraction for all samples. A site can still have in situ surveys at more than one plot, or more than once in a year, and have canopy mapped more than once in a year. Each in situ survey therefore has its own survey_id in survey_in_situ, which the plants of a size census carry, and each canopy map is its own row in survey_canopy. However, no models estimate seasonal variation (i.e., within a year); canopy maps of the same site-year share the same biomass per m² of canopy, and in situ surveys of the same site-year share the same mean plant weight (see Timing for details).

Datasets

The columns of each dataset, as given by kb_data_columns(). Each site must be spelled the same way in every dataset: the datasets are joined by site and year, and a misspelled site is read as a new site.

One row per harvested plant, with its size, wet weight, site, and year. Used by kb_fit_weight_nereo(), kb_fit_weight_macro() and checked by kb_check_data_weight_nereo(), kb_check_data_weight_macro().

Nereocystis

Column Units Allowed Example Description
diameter_mm mm > 0 26.8 The plant diameter, measured as in the size data.
weight_kg kg > 0 0.73 The plant’s weight.
site any text otter_cove The site the plant was sampled at.
year whole number or text 2024 The year the plant was sampled.

Macrocystis

Column Units Allowed Example Description
fronds whole number >= 1 5 The number of fronds reaching 1 m above the holdfast.
weight_kg kg > 0 3.96 The plant’s weight.
site any text seal_ledge The site the plant was sampled at.
year whole number or text 2024 The year the plant was sampled.

One row per measured plant, with its size, site, and year. Used by kb_fit_size_nereo() and checked by kb_check_data_size_sample_nereo().

Column Units Allowed Example Description
diameter_mm mm > 0 26.8 The plant diameter, measured as in the weight data.
site any text otter_cove The site the plant was measured at.
year whole number or text 2024 The year the plant was measured.

One row per counted plant, with its size and the survey_id of its survey; a partial plant counts as half. Used by kb_predict_biomass_in_situ() and checked by kb_check_data_size_census_nereo(), kb_check_data_size_census_macro().

Nereocystis

Column Units Allowed Example Description
survey_id a survey_id of the in situ data otter_cove-2024-1 The survey the plant was counted in.
diameter_mm mm > 0 26.8 The plant diameter, measured as in the weight data.
partial
optional 		TRUE or FALSE FALSE Whether the plant counts as half, such as a plant on the edge of a transect.

Macrocystis

Column Units Allowed Example Description
survey_id a survey_id of the in situ data otter_cove-2024-1 The survey the plant was counted in.
fronds whole number >= 1 5 The number of fronds reaching 1 m above the holdfast.
partial
optional 		TRUE or FALSE FALSE Whether the plant counts as half, such as a plant on the edge of a transect.

One row per in situ survey, with its survey_id, site, year, and survey area, and, where the canopy was mapped over it, its plot cover. Used by kb_predict_biomass_in_situ() and checked by kb_check_data_survey_in_situ().

Column Units Allowed Example Description
survey_id text or number, unique to each survey otter_cove-2024-1 The survey’s identifier.
site any text otter_cove The site surveyed.
year whole number or text 2024 The year of the survey.
survey_area_m2 m² > 0 182.3 The area surveyed for plants.
plants
optional 		whole number >= 0 360 The number of plants counted, given only when sizes come from a size sample.
plot_area_m2
optional 		m² > 0, or missing 232.5 The area of the plot polygon bounding the survey area that the canopy cover is measured over.
canopy_area_m2
optional 		m² >= 0 and <= plot_area_m2, or missing 46.3 The canopy area delineated within the plot polygon.
canopy_tide_height_m
optional 		m any number, or missing 0.75 The tide height when the canopy was imaged, relative to chart datum, ideally close to 0 m and at most 2 m, or 0 for canopy already corrected for tide.

One row per canopy map, with its site, year, and mapped canopy. Used by kb_predict_biomass_canopy() and checked by kb_check_data_survey_canopy().

Column Units Allowed Example Description
site any text otter_cove The site mapped.
year whole number or text 2024 The year of the map.
canopy_area_m2 m² >= 0 and <= classified_area_m2 7528 The canopy area mapped.
canopy_tide_height_m m any number 1.0 The tide height when the canopy was imaged, relative to chart datum, ideally close to 0 m and at most 2 m, or 0 for canopy already corrected for tide.
classified_area_m2 m² > 0 18478 The water area the canopy classification covered, including water where no canopy was found.

One row per tissue sample, with no site or year. Used by kb_fit_wetdry_nereo(), kb_fit_wetdry_macro() and checked by kb_check_data_wetdry_nereo(), kb_check_data_wetdry_macro().

Column Units Allowed Example Description
wet_mass_g g > 0 4.16 The mass of the tissue sample before drying.
dry_mass_g g > 0 and < wet_mass_g 0.33 The mass of the tissue sample after drying.

One row per tissue sample, with no site or year. Used by kb_fit_carbon_nereo(), kb_fit_carbon_macro() and checked by kb_check_data_carbon_nereo(), kb_check_data_carbon_macro().

Column Units Allowed Example Description
sample_mass_mg mg > 0 2.33 The mass of the dried tissue sample analysed.
carbon_mass_ug µg > 0 and less than the sample mass 594 The mass of carbon measured in the sample.

One row per tissue sample, with no site or year. Used by kb_fit_nitrogen_nereo(), kb_fit_nitrogen_macro() and checked by kb_check_data_nitrogen_nereo(), kb_check_data_nitrogen_macro().

Column Units Allowed Example Description
sample_mass_mg mg > 0 2.33 The mass of the dried tissue sample analysed.
nitrogen_mass_ug µg > 0 and less than the sample mass 42.9 The mass of nitrogen measured in the sample.

Checking the data

Each dataset has a kb_check_data_*() function that checks the data against the format expected by the model fitting functions (e.g., column names and values) and gives an informative error message when a correction is required. See the data checks in the reference for details on the format requirements.

kb_check_data_weight_nereo(data_weight_sim_nereo)

kb_check_data_weight_nereo(data_weight_sim_nereo[, c("diameter_mm", "site")])
#> Error in `kb_check_data_weight_nereo()`:
#> ! `data_weight_sim_nereo[, c("diameter_mm", "site")]` must include 'weight_kg' and 'year'.
